messages.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
messages.text: September proposals: (1) pause unity_video_retarget from Sep 1 (fraud still ongoing, partial credit from Unity for July), move its ~$2.7k/day to unity_playable_installs; (2) release the 3% holdback into AppLovin, best D7 ROAS on mature cohorts; (3) Android bids unchanged until 2.15.0 ships.

replies.author: Chloe Nguyen
replies.text: Jul-Aug ran ~$54.7k/day, about 2% above the base plan pace, so releasing the holdback is fine as long as September stays at plan. Finance OK.
